description: This file defines extension methods for configuring log storage-based log consistency providers within the Orleans hosting framework. It provides methods to add default or custom log storage providers to the silo builder, facilitating dependency injection and service configuration.

classes.name: LogStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to add log storage-based log consistency providers.

methods.name: AddLogStorageBasedLogConsistencyProviderAsDefault
methods.description: Adds a log storage log consistency provider as the default provider for the silo builder.

methods.name: AddLogStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Adds a log storage log consistency provider with a specified name to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddLogStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Internal method that registers the log storage log consistency provider services into the service collection.
